_source: WFRP4th - Critical Hits Reference Sheet v1.04, by jakob@bindslet.dk (fan reference sheet, not official Cubicle 7 text) - see NOTICE.md

head.name: Dramatic Injury
head.description: A fine wound across the forehead and cheek. Gain 1 Bleeding Condition. Once the wound is healed, the impressive scar it leaves provides a bonus of +1 SL to appropriate social Tests. You can only gain this benefit once.

head.name: Minor Cut
head.description: The strike opens your cheek and blood flies everywhere. Gain 1 Bleeding Condition.

head.name: Poked Eye
head.description: The blow glances across your eye socket. Gain 1 Blinded condition.

head.name: Ear Bash
head.description: Your ear takes a sickening impact, leaving it ringing. Gain 1 Deafened Condition.

head.name: Rattling Blow
head.description: The blow floods your vision with spots and flashing lights. Gain 1 Stunned Condition.

head.name: Black Eye
head.description: A solid blow hits your eye, leaving tears and much pain. Gain 2 Blinded Conditions.

head.name: Sliced Ear
head.description: Your side of your head takes a hard blow, cutting deep into your ear. Gain 2 Deafened and 1 Bleeding Condition.

head.name: Struck Forehead
head.description: A solid blow thumps into the center of your forehead. Gain 2 Bleeding Conditions and a Blinded Condition that cannot be removed until all Bleeding Conditions are removed.

head.name: Fractured Jaw
head.description: With a sickening crunch, pain fills your face as the blow fractures your jaw. Gain 2 Stunned Conditions. Suffer a Broken Bone (Minor) injury.

head.name: Major Eye Wound
head.description: The blow cracks across your eye socket. Gain 1 Bleeding Condition. Also gain 1 Blinded Condition that cannot be removed until you receive Medical Attention.

head.name: Major Ear Wound
head.description: The blow damages your ear, leaving you with permanent hearing loss in one ear. Suffer a -20 penalty on all Tests relating to hearing. If you suffer this result again, your hearing is permanently lost as the second ear falls quiet. Only magic can heal this.

head.name: Broken Nose
head.description: A solid blow to the center of your face causing blood to pour. Gain 2 Bleeding Conditions. Make a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test, or also gain a Stunned Condition. After this wound has healed, gain +1/-1SL on social rolls, depending on context, unless Surgery is used to reset the nose.

head.name: Broken Jaw
head.description: The crack is sickening as the blow hits you under the chin, breaking your jaw. Gain 3 Stunned Conditions. Make a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test or gain an Unconscious Condition. Suffer a Broken Bone (Major) injury.

head.name: Concussive Blow
head.description: Your brain rattles in your skull as blood spurts from your nose and ears. Take 1 Deafened, 2 Bleeding, and 1d10 Stunned Conditions. Gain a Fatigued Condition that lasts for 1d10 days. If you receive another Critical Wound to your head while suffering this Fatigued Condition, make an Average (+20) Endurance Test or also gain an Unconscious Condition.

head.name: Smashed Mouth
head.description: With a sickening crunch, your mouth is suddenly filled with broken teeth and blood. Gain 2 Bleeding Conditions. Lose 1d10 teeth - Amputation (Easy).

head.name: Mangled Ear
head.description: Little is left of your ear as the blow tears it apart. You gain 3 Deafened and 2 Bleeding Conditions. Lose your ear - Amputation (Average).

head.name: Devastated Eye
head.description: A strike to your eye completely bursts it, causing extraordinary pain. Gain 3 Blinded, 2 Bleeding, and 1 Stunned Condition. Lose your eye - Amputation (Difficult).

head.name: Disfiguring Blow
head.description: The blow smashes your entire face, destroying your eye and nose in a cloud of blood. Gain 3 Bleeding, 3 Blinded and 2 Stunned Conditions. Lose your eye and nose - Amputation (Hard).

head.name: Mangled Jaw
head.description: The blow almost removes your jaw as it utterly destroys your tongue, sending teeth flying in a shower of blood. Gain 4 Bleeding and 3 Stunned Conditions. Make a Very Hard (-30) Endurance Test or gain an Unconscious Condition. Suffer a Broken Bone (Major) injury and lose your tongue and 1d10 teeth - Amputation (Hard).

head.name: Decapitated
head.description: Your head is entirely severed from your neck and soars through the air, landing 1d10 feet away in a random direction (see Scatter). Your body collapses, instantly dead.

body.name: 'Tis But A Scratch!
body.description: Gain 1 Bleeding Condition.

body.name: Gut Blow
body.description: Gain 1 Stunned Condition. Pass an Easy (+40) Endurance Test, or vomit, gaining the Prone Condition.

body.name: Low Blow!
body.description: Make a Hard (-20) Endurance Test or gain 3 Stunned Condition.

body.name: Twisted Back
body.description: Suffer a Torn Muscle (Minor) injury.

body.name: Winded
body.description: Gain the Stunned Condition. Make an Average (+20) Endurance Test, or gain the Prone Condition. Movement is halved for 1d10 rounds as you get your breath back.

body.name: Bruised Ribs
body.description: All Agility-based Tests suffer a -10 penalty for 1d10 days.

body.name: Wrenched Collar Bone
body.description: Randomly select one arm. Drop whatever is held in that hand; the arm is useless for 1d10 rounds (see Amputated Parts).

body.name: Ragged Wound
body.description: Take 2 Bleeding Conditions.

body.name: Cracked Ribs
body.description: The hit cracks one or more ribs. Gain the Stunned Condition. Gain a Broken Bone (Minor) injury.

body.name: Gaping Wound
body.description: Take 3 Bleeding Conditions. Until you receive Surgery, any Wounds you receive to the Body Hit Location will inflict an additional Bleeding Condition as the cut reopens.

body.name: Painful Cut
body.description: Gain 2 Bleeding Conditions and the Stunned Condition. Take a Hard (-20) Endurance Test or gain the Unconscious Condition as you black out from the pain. Unless you achieve 4+ SL, you also scream out in agony.

body.name: Arterial Damage
body.description: Gain 4 Bleeding Conditions. Until you receive Surgery, every time you receive Damage to the Body Hit Location, gain 2 Bleeding Conditions.

body.name: Pulled Back
body.description: Your back turns to white pain as you pull a muscle. Suffer a Torn Muscle (Major) injury.

body.name: Fractured Hip
body.description: Gain the Stunned Condition. Take a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test or also gain the Prone Condition. Suffer a Broken Bone (Minor) injury.

body.name: Major Chest Wound
body.description: You take a significant wound to your chest, flensing skin from muscle and sinew. Take 4 Bleeding Conditions. Until you receive Surgery, to stitch the wound together, any Wounds you receive to the Body Hit Location will also inflict 2 Bleeding Conditions as the tears reopen.

body.name: Gut Wound
body.description: Contract a Festering Wound (see Disease and Infection) and gain 2 Bleeding Conditions.

body.name: Smashed Rib Cage
body.description: Gain a Stunned Condition that can only be removed through Medical Attention, and suffer a Broken Bone (Major) injury.

body.name: Broken Collar Bone
body.description: Gain the Unconscious Condition until you receive Medical Attention, and suffer a Broken Bone (Major) injury.

body.name: Internal bleeding
body.description: Gain a Bleeding Condition that can only be removed through Surgery. Contract Blood Rot (see Disease and Infection).

body.name: Torn Apart
body.description: You are hacked in two. The top half lands in a random direction, and all characters within 2 yards are showered in blood.

arm.name: Jarred Arm
arm.description: Your arm is jarred in the attack. Drop whatever was held in that hand.

arm.name: Minor cut
arm.description: Gain a Bleeding Condition as your upper arm is cut badly.

arm.name: Sprain
arm.description: You sprain your arm, suffering a Torn Muscle (Minor) injury.

arm.name: Badly Jarred Arm
arm.description: Your arm is badly jarred in the attack. Drop whatever was held in that hand, which is useless for 1d10-TB rounds (minimum 1). For this time, treat the hand as lost (see Amputated Part).

arm.name: Torn Muscles
arm.description: The blow slams into your forearm. Gain a Bleeding Condition and a Torn Muscle (Minor) injury.

arm.name: Bleeding Hand
arm.description: Your hand is cut badly, making your grip slippery. Take 1 Bleeding Condition. While suffering from that Bleeding Condition, make an Average (+20) Dexterity Test before taking any Action that requires something being held in that hand; if you fail, the item slips from your grip.

arm.name: Wrenched Arm
arm.description: Your arm is almost pulled from its socket. Drop whatever is held in the associate hand; the arm is useless for 1d10 Rounds (see Amputated Parts).

arm.name: Gaping Wound
arm.description: The blow opens a deep, gaping wound. Gain 2 Bleeding Conditions. Until you receive Surgery to stitch up the cut, any associated Arm Damage you receive will also inflict 1 Bleeding Condition as the wound reopens.

arm.name: Clean Break
arm.description: An audible crack resounds as the blow strikes your arm. Drop whatever was held in the associated hand and gain a Broken Bone (Minor) injury. Pass a Difficult (-10) Endurance Test or gain a Stunned Condition.

arm.name: Ruptured Ligament
arm.description: You immediately drop whatever was held in that hand. Suffer a Torn Muscle (Major) injury.

arm.name: Deep Cut
arm.description: Gain 2 Bleeding Conditions as your arm is mangled. Gain 1 Stunned Condition and suffer a Torn Muscle (Minor) injury. Take a Hard (-20) Endurance Test or gain the Unconscious Condition.

arm.name: Damaged Artery
arm.description: Gain 4 Bleeding Conditions. Until you receive Surgery, every time you take Damage to this Arm Hit Location gain 2 Bleeding Conditions.

arm.name: Crushed Elbow
arm.description: The blow crushes your elbow, splintering bone and cartilage. You immediately drop whatever was held in that hand and gain a Broken Bone (Major) injury.

arm.name: Dislocated Shoulder
arm.description: Your arm is wrenched out of its socket. Pass a Hard (-20) Endurance Test or gain the Stunned and Prone Condition. Drop whatever is held in that hand: the arm is useless and counts as lost (see Amputated Part). Gain 1 Stunned Condition until you receive Medical Attention. After this initial Medical Attention, an Extended Routine (+20) Heal Test needing 6 SL is required to reset the arm, at which point you regain its use. Tests made using this arm suffer a -10 penalty for 1d10 days.

arm.name: Severed Finger
arm.description: You gape in horror as a finger flies - Amputation (Average). Gain a Bleeding condition.

arm.name: Cleft Hand
arm.description: Your hand splays open from the blow. Lose 1 finger - Amputation (Difficult). Gain 2 Bleeding and 1 Stunned Condition. For every succeeding Round in which you don't receive Medical Attention, you lose another finger as the wound tears; if you run out of fingers, you lose the hand - Amputation (Difficult).

arm.name: Mauled Bicep
arm.description: The blow almost separates bicep and tendon from bone, leaving an ugly wound that sprays blood over you and your opponent. You automatically drop anything held in the associated hand and suffers a Torn Muscle (Major) injury and 2 Bleeding and 1 Stun Condition.

arm.name: Mangled Hand
arm.description: Your hand is left a mauled, bleeding mess. You lose your hand - Amputation (Hard). Gain 2 Bleeding Condition. Take a Hard (-20) Endurance Test or gain the Stunned and Prone Conditions.

arm.name: Sliced Tendons
arm.description: Your tendons are cut by the blow, leaving your arm hanging useless - Amputation (Very Hard). Gain 3 Bleeding, 1 Prone, and 1 Stunned Condition. Pass a Hard (-20) Endurance Test or gain the Unconscious Condition.

arm.name: Brutal Dismemberment
arm.description: Your arm is severed, spraying arterial blood 1d10 feet in a random direction (see Scatter), before the blow follows through to your chest.

leg.name: Stubbed Toe
leg.description: In the scuffle, you stub your toe. Pass a Routine (+20) Endurance Test or suffer -10 on Agility Tests until the end of the next turn.

leg.name: Twisted Ankle
leg.description: You go over your ankle, hurting it. Agility Tests suffer a -10 penalty for 1d10 rounds.

leg.name: Minor Cut
leg.description: Gain 1 Bleeding Condition.

leg.name: Lost Footing
leg.description: In the scuffle you lose your footing. Pass a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test or gain the Prone Condition.

leg.name: Thigh Strike
leg.description: A painful blow slams into your upper thigh. Gain a Bleeding Condition and take an Average (+20) Endurance Test or stumble, gaining a Prone Condition.

leg.name: Sprained Ankle
leg.description: You sprain your ankle, giving you a Torn Muscle (Minor) injury.

leg.name: Twisted Knee
leg.description: You twist your knee too far. Agility Tests suffer a -20 penalty for 1d10 rounds.

leg.name: Badly Cut Toe
leg.description: Gain 1 Bleeding Condition. After the encounter, make a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test. If you fail, lose 1 toe - Amputation (Average).

leg.name: Bad Cut
leg.description: Gain 2 Bleeding conditions as a deep wound opens up your shin. Pass a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test or gain the Prone Condition.

leg.name: Twisted Knee
leg.description: You badly twist your knee trying to avoid your opponent. Gain a Torn Muscle (Major) injury.

leg.name: Hacked Leg
leg.description: A cut bites down into the hip. Gain 2 Bleeding, 1 Prone Condition, and suffer a Broken Bone (Minor) injury. Further, take a Hard (-20) Endurance Test or also gain a Stunned condition from the pain.

leg.name: Torn Thigh
leg.description: Gain 3 Bleeding Conditions as the weapon opens up your upper thigh. Pass a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test or gain the Prone Condition. Until you receive Surgery to stitch up the wound, each time you receive Damage to this Leg, also receive 1 Bleeding Condition.

leg.name: Ruptured Tendon
leg.description: Gain the Prone and Stunned Condition as one of your tendons tears badly. Pass a Hard (-20) Endurance Test or gain the Unconscious Condition. Your leg is useless (see Amputated Parts). Suffer a Torn Muscle (Major) injury.

leg.name: Carved Shin
leg.description: The weapon drives clean through your leg by the knee, slicing into bone and through tendons. Gain a Stunned and Prone Condition. Further, suffer a Torn Muscle (Major) and Broken Bone (Minor) injury.

leg.name: Broken Knee
leg.description: The blow hacks into your kneecap, shattering it into several pieces. You gain 1 Bleeding, 1 Prone, and Stunned Condition, and a Broken Bone (Major) Injury as you fall to the ground, clutching your ruined leg.

leg.name: Dislocated Knee
leg.description: Your knee is wrenched out of its socket. Gain the Prone Condition. Pass a Hard (-20) Endurance Test, or gain the Stunned Condition, which is not removed until you receive Medical Attention. After this initial Medical Attention, an Extended Routine (+20) Heal Test needing 6 SL is required to reset the knee at which point you regain its use. Movement is halved, and Tests made using this leg suffer a -10 penalty for d10 days.

leg.name: Crushed Foot
leg.description: The blow crushes your foot. Make an Average (+20) Endurance Test; if you fail, gain the Prone condition and lose 1 toe, plus 1 additional toe for each SL below 0 - Amputation (Average). Gain 2 Bleeding Conditions. If you don't receive Surgery within 1d10 days, you will lose the foot entirely.

leg.name: Severed Foot
leg.description: Your foot is severed at the ankle and lands 1d10 feet away in a random direction - Amputation (Hard) (see Scatter). You gain 3 Bleeding, 2 Stunned, and 1 Prone Condition.

leg.name: Cut Tendon
leg.description: A major tendon at the back of your leg is cut, causing you to scream out in pain as your leg collapses. Gain 2 Bleeding, 2 Stunned, and 1 Prone Condition and look on in horror as your leg never works again - Amputation (Very Hard).

leg.name: Shattered Pelvis
leg.description: The blow shatters your pelvis, severing one leg then driving through to the next. You die instantly from traumatic shock.
